decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the proposed development, for the fencing alterations, for the supports for the CCTV cameras, and for the alterations to the west elevation of the building shall match those used for the existing fencing and building.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the external surfaces of the gate houses , and of the external surface of the retaining wall fronting the highway have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, and the development shall only be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until full details of landscape works for the northern boundary of the site where the land is to be back-filled behind the proposed retaining wall, have been submitted to and have been approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These details shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities and implementation programme. Any works which may be approved shall be carried out in the first available planting season, following the provision of the retaining wall and the back-filling of the land

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a schedule of landscape maintenance for a minimum period of 5 years has been submitted to and has been approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The schedule shall include details of the arrangements for its implementation.  The development shall be carried out only in accordance with the approved schedule.
description: Alterations and additions to the height of the existing fencing and entrance/exit gates to provide anti intrusion capability, the provision of two gate houses, alterations to the west elevation of the building to comprise re-positioning of the existing service doors and adding new ones, the infilling of a dock leveller and alterations to another, the provision of steps from a fire exit and the installation of ten CCTV cameras mounted on the building, the new gatehouses and on poles.
